notes.title: 📢 It's been a while! We have some great news to share!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090437/2f282b771bb27c31c58299990e8ac6fe242e19a4.png[/img]

Hello!

We hope you're doing well!

It's been a while. Here in South Korea, it's already autumn.

Today, I want to share some exciting news with all of you.

Firstly, our game has been selected as the winner in the "Best Innovation" category

at MWU Korea Award 2023, hosted by Unity!

We owe this achievement to all of you.

Secondly, we have plans for an update.

We'll share more details later on.

We are truly grateful for your continuous love and support for our game.

Thank you! ❤

notes.title: 🎊 Selected as Top 36 in MWU Korea Awards 🎊
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090437/aad5e71a7deaff56a8026fb0d95ae1945df09aad.jpg[/img]

It's been a while since we greeted you with the arrival of autumn.

Today, we have some exciting news to share with you.

[Rose and Lotus: Petals of Memories] has been selected as 
the Best Innovation game in the MWU Korea Awards hosted by Unity!

through a lucky draw. Please take note!

notes.title: 📢 6/30 (Fri) Patch Notes
notes.notes:
For smooth gameplay, the following changes and improvements have been made.
These updates were based on feedback from the players:

[list]
[*] Chapter 4: The hint image for the Piano Puzzle has been improved to make it easier to solve.
[*] Chapter 5: The hint image for the Face Model Puzzle has been improved to make it easier to solve.
[*] Chapter 9: The hint image for the Butterfly Wing Puzzle has been improved to make it easier to solve.
[*] Some dialogue lines in Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese have been changed.
[/list]

Always happy to your opinion and welcome your love. Thank you.

notes.title: 📢 Announcement of Release Delay due to Steam Review Issue
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090437/6b3d95a3c06ba9370759aaefacb72dfef5d295cc.png[/img]

Hi.

We have to announce that the release schedule of [ROSE AND LOTUS: PETALS OF MEMORIES],
which was planned for today (6/28), is likely to be slightly delayed.
We ask for your understanding.

Due to Steam review issues, we anticipate a delay of approximately 1-2 days.
Once the game has successfully passed the review, we will share the revised official release date as soon as possible.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused to those who have been eagerly waiting for the game's release and to our supportive backers.
If you have any questions, please leave us a message, and we will respond promptly.

Thank you!

notes.title: Character Introduction: Janghwa and Hongryeon
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090437/e19c3b6f3bc52c525e731c4c79c69932485b9428.jpg[/img]

Janghwa, the protagonist, is a curious and spirited character.
Determined to escape from the oppression of their stepmother, they make a decision to leave this place together with their precious younger sister, Hongryeon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090437/481de4b80706a333f515164cbf53bcfc81a93a28.jpg[/img]

Hongryeon always carries a doll with her. She is timid and fearful, but she resolves to follow her sister, Janghwa, in escaping from this place.

notes.title: Greetings everyone!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090437/bc7dfcde1c86e10379b4933f9dd3b9b1ac9107f1.png[/img]

We are the "Puzzle Team" of 5minlab.

[b][Rose and Lotus:Petals of Memories][/b] is a point-and-click puzzle game based on the Korean fairy tale 'Janghwa Hongryeon'.
As the player character in the game, you have to solve puzzles hidden throughout the room.
Our game offers not only the fun of discovering and combining clues, but also rich content such as character stories, artwork, and music, which we have carefully prepared. 
We hope you'll enjoy experiencing all of these elements together and meeting us at the end of each puzzle!

Thank You!
